preconditions.description: Number of cities N is between 3 and 500.
Number of roads M is between 3 and 10000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= X_i <= N for X_i in X)
preconditions.description: Each city index X_i is between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= Y_i <= N for Y_i in Y)
preconditions.description: Each city index Y_i is between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(X_i != Y_i for X_i, Y_i in zip(X, Y))
preconditions.description: No road connects a city to itself.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= Z_i <= 100000 for Z_i in Z)
preconditions.description: Each road's importance value Z_i is between 1 and 100000.

postconditions.description: The output is the product of separation values over all unordered pairs of cities, modulo 10^9 + 7.
